root_outcome: Stable multilingual voice brain dump: a real multi-minute Russian/English code-switched recording becomes individually reviewable, correctly split, language-faithful task proposals with full transcript provenance, consent that names every configured vendor, and per-proposal grounding that never poisons the batch — with FR-016 grounding tolerance as the single remaining lane.

product_decisions.question: When transcription and reconciliation are handled by different vendors, what must external-processing consent name?
product_decisions.answer: Consent must name every configured vendor (consent.providers), and each pipeline stage re-verifies its own vendor is in the consented set and fails closed before data leaves the device; the recording UI shows the real configured vendor names discovered from GET /api/brain-dump-providers, never a hardcoded label.
product_decisions.evidence_ref: spec.md FR-011/FR-012, US2; constitution Principle I; plan.md decision 5; verified SC-006

product_decisions.question: Should reconciliation batch multiple utterances per model call to raise proposal yield?
product_decisions.answer: No. Windowed/batched reconciliation was tested live 2026-07-29 and rejected: +3 proposals for +21% cost and a reintroduced translation regression. The full-list single reconciler feed with per-proposal grounding is retained.
product_decisions.evidence_ref: spec.md Out of Scope; plan.md 'Remaining work'; tasks.md Notes

product_decisions.question: Until FR-016 lands, how should proposals that need multi-clause modifier, self-correction, or garbled-proper-noun tolerance behave?
product_decisions.answer: They fail closed rather than guess (measured cost ≈ one third of real-dump proposals). Anti-hallucination grounding (FR-009) is never weakened to raise yield; FR-016 is deferred to its own lane.
product_decisions.evidence_ref: spec.md FR-016, Edge Cases; plan.md FR-016 lane; tasks.md Phase 5

lanes.outcome: Multilingual STT + morphology-tolerant grounding + per-proposal skip + multi-vendor consent + test hermeticity, delivered and live-verified 2026-07-29 (covers US1, US2, US3).
acceptance_evidence: SC-001: reference 4-minute RU/EN recording yields 15 committed tasks (prior: 0)
SC-002: ≈82% of actionable utterances yield exactly one correct proposal (prior ~33%)
SC-003: zero translated titles on the reference corpus (prior 9 of 50)
SC-005: batch with an unverifiable proposal still delivers every verified sibling
SC-006: consent omitting the transcription vendor fails closed with no upload
SC-008: 875 backend / 443 frontend tests green with the feature active
Live e2e 2026-07-29: real 4-min m4a -> 62 utterance segments -> 15 committed tasks

lanes.outcome: Extend semantic verification to tolerate multi-clause modifier grounding within one cited utterance, mid-utterance self-corrections (prefer the corrected value), and transcription-garbled proper nouns, without weakening FR-009 anti-hallucination guarantees.
acceptance_evidence: FR-016 fixtures for the three shapes ground and commit while the FR-009 rejection matrix (T021) stays fully green
Reference-corpus evaluation harness records a positive recovered-proposal delta with zero new translations and zero new false splits
No regression in SC-003/SC-004 or the anti-hallucination rejection tests before release

risks: Real-provider dependence (Deepgram nova-3, OpenAI gpt-4o): provider outage, quota exhaustion, or contract drift degrades capture; mitigated by terminal-vs-retryable classification, bounded retries, checkpoint resume, and deterministic CI providers.
Grounding tolerance (FR-016) must not erode FR-009: any loosening risks admitting hallucinated or recombined proposals; the FR-009 rejection matrix is a standing gate on the fr016 lane.
Split-vendor consent correctness is privacy-critical: a stage that skips its per-vendor guard would upload without consent; enforced fail-closed per stage and covered by consent-mismatch tests.
Reference-corpus overfitting: metrics are from one founder-read 50-utterance corpus; broader multilingual capture may shift boundary precision and translation rates.
non_goals: Windowed/batched reconciliation calls (tested and rejected 2026-07-29: +21% cost, translation regression).
Inferring structured fields (due dates, tags, projects, priority) from speech.
Live streaming transcription vendor changes for the provisional preview track.
Consent UX copy and first-class structured task fields.
Any change to the AsyncOperation state machine, chunk-upload manifest identity, or freeze/confirm idempotency contract.
